1.web: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
1.asv: Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

2.web: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
2.asv: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.

3.web: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
3.asv: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.

4.web: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
4.asv: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

5.web: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
5.asv: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, WhereI heard a language that I knew not.

6.web: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
6.asv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.

7.web: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
7.asv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. [Selah

8.web: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
8.asv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

9.web: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
9.asv: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

10.web: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
10.asv: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

11.web: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
11.asv: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.

12.web: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
12.asv: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

13.web: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
13.asv: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!

14.web: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
14.asv: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.

15.web: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
15.asv: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.

16.web: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
16.asv: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.
